proposed_alignment_bands_for_fresh_seed_.derivation_principle: Both bands below are derived from properties INDEPENDENT of the already-observed twin values (0.8719378145777505 and -0.12792667746543884) specifically to avoid curve-fitting a threshold to numbers already seen -- exactly the failure mode this disclosure exists to flag.

rms_ratio.no_response_band: within +/-1% of the anchor value (comparable order of magnitude to the ~0.01-0.1% cross-process admissibility drift already observed on anchor-reproduction legs elsewhere in this thread -- a 1% floor gives ample margin above that noise)
rms_ratio.material_response_band: >=5% relative deviation from the anchor value
rms_ratio.rationale: Mirrors the same deviation-from-reference band SHAPE already used for R_spectral (a reference value + a small/large-deviation split), at a threshold set from the OTHER admissibility numbers in this thread rather than from this instrument's own already-seen twin value.

min_per_row_cosine.rationale: For two independent random unit vectors in R^1024 (the dimensionality of a gate_proj row here), the expected cosine similarity is 0 with standard deviation ~1/sqrt(1024)~=0.03125. A material-response floor of 0.3 is roughly 9-10 standard deviations from pure randomness -- i.e., 'below 0.3' is a principled statement that genuine decorrelation occurred, derived from the geometry of high-dimensional random vectors, not from the already-observed -0.128 value.
